title: May I?

objectives.label: Ask to look
objectives.descriptorEN: Use 'Lahko ___?' with the verb for looking to get him to open the box.

objectives.label: Ask to try
objectives.descriptorEN: Use the same frame with a different verb to get a piece of the cake.

objectives.label: Ask before you ask
objectives.descriptorEN: Open a question of your own with 'Lahko vprašam?' — then ask it.

frameEN: Slavko has brought a box, and he won't say what's in it.
Nothing here is going to be handed to you — you'll have to ask.
Today you learn how to ask whether you may do something.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Nekaj sem ti prinesel! Tukaj, v tej škatli.
n1.en: I've brought you something! Here, in this box.
n1.deliverySL: [bursting with excitement] Nekaj sem ti prinesel! [conspiratorial] Tukaj, v tej škatli.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Ne povem! Presenečenje je. Če hočeš videti, me vprašaj: Lahko pogledam?
n2.en: I'm not telling! It's a surprise. If you want to see, ask me: May I look?
n2.deliverySL: [teasing, singsong] Ne povem! Presenečenje je. [helpfully] Če hočeš videti, me vprašaj: [clearly] Lahko pogledam?
n2.slowSL: Ne povem … presenečenje je … Če hočeš videti … me vprašaj … Lahko pogledam?
n2.deliverySlowSL: [teasing, drawn out] Ne povem … [slower] presenečenje je … [slower] Če hočeš videti … [slower, deliberately] me vprašaj … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Lahko pogledam?

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Kar poglej! To je potica. Potica!
n3.en: Go right ahead and look! This is potica. Potica!
n3.deliverySL: [delighted, lifting the lid] Kar poglej! [proudly] To je potica. [savouring the word] Potica!
n3.slowSL: Kar poglej … To je … potica … Potica.
n3.deliverySlowSL: [warmly] Kar poglej … [slower, deliberately] To je … [very slowly, drawn out] potica … [very slowly, drawn out] Potica.

n4.speaker: npc
n4.deliverySL: [mouth full, blissful] Mmm! [savouring, oblivious] Dobra je. [chewing happily] Mmm!

n5.speaker: npc
n5.sl: Ojoj, oprosti! Ti pa nič. Reci mi: Lahko poskusim?
n5.en: Oh no, sorry! And nothing for you. Say to me: May I try some?
n5.deliverySL: [suddenly embarrassed] Ojoj, oprosti! [sheepish] Ti pa nič. [encouraging] Reci mi: [clearly] Lahko poskusim?
n5.slowSL: Ojoj, oprosti … Ti pa nič … Reci mi … Lahko poskusim?
n5.deliverySlowSL: [embarrassed, slowly] Ojoj, oprosti … [slower] Ti pa nič … [slower, deliberately] Reci mi … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Lahko poskusim?

stallHandlers.label: Ask if you may try some

n6.speaker: npc
n6.deliverySL: [warmly, handing over a piece] Seveda! Izvoli.

n7.speaker: npc
n7.en: My grandma bakes it. Every Sunday!

n8.speaker: npc
n8.sl: Če me hočeš kaj vprašati, reci: Lahko vprašam?
n8.en: If you want to ask me something, say: May I ask?
n8.deliverySL: [helpfully, leaning in] Če me hočeš kaj vprašati, reci: [clearly] Lahko vprašam?
n8.slowSL: Če me hočeš kaj vprašati … reci … Lahko vprašam?
n8.deliverySlowSL: [patiently, slowly] Če me hočeš kaj vprašati … [slower, deliberately] reci … [very slowly, enunciating every syllable] Lahko vprašam?

stallHandlers.label: Ask if you may ask him something
Ask him for the word for grandma

n10.speaker: npc
n10.sl: Grandma? Babica! Zdaj grem k babici. Adijo!
n10.en: Grandma? 'Babica'! Now I'm off to my grandma's. Bye!
n10.deliverySL: [delighted] Grandma? Babica! [cheerful, already leaving] Zdaj grem k babici. Adijo!
